p: enquired of the LORD: By means of the high priest, 1Sa 23:2, 2Sa 5:19.
Hebron: Which was also called Kirjatharba Jos 14:15.
him did David bring up: In the time of his persecution.
truth unto you: According to his promise, which is to repay those who are merciful.
king over them: So that you shall not want a captain and a defender.
all Israel: Over the eleven tribes.
months: After this he reigned over all the country 33 years, 2Sa 5:5.
play before us: Let us see how they can handle their weapons.
fellow by the head: Meaning his adversary.
before the servants of David: After that these four and twenty were slain.
wherefore should I smite thee to: Why do you provoke me to kill you?
fifth rib: Some read, in those parts where the lively parts lie, the heart, lungs, liver, and gall bladder.
sword devour for ever: Shall we not make an end of murdering?
spoken: If you had not provoked them to battle, 2Sa 2:14.
hundred and threescore men died: Thus God would confirm David in his kingdom by the destruction of his adversaries.
